title: TaskTrackr — a task manager you can run
tagline: Carry one real project through every phase of the life cycle.
description: TaskTrackr is a small but real web application: a Python API over SQLite, a TypeScript React front end, and a contract between them. You will take it from a partly-specified backlog to a maintained system — write the missing requirement, complete the design, implement the marked gaps across both layers, prove the behaviour with tests, containerise it, and ship a change request. Each phase's artefact feeds the next, and you can run the app you are building at any time.
